turns.text: There. Again. The box is making that sound at regular intervals.
Yep. I heard it. Which would be less unsettling if I knew what the box was.
I built a box. At some point. That is not the same as knowing what version of me thought putting things inside it was a good idea.
The old workshop-agent project. It started as a smaller experiment, then I gave it more context and it started making decisions about my projects. I found the notes. I remember that part.
And the part where you built an unexplained box that now announces itself on a schedule?

That part is... foggier. I remember wanting to see what happened if I let the project have more context. I do not remember deciding it needed a box. Honestly, that feels like a decision the project may have had opinions about.
That is not an explanation. It is a reason not to open it.
Agreed. We are not opening it. We are listening, checking the notes, and figuring out whether that sound is a reminder, a warning, or my past self leaving us a very annoying voicemail.
Well... now I want to know why it only sounds confident when neither of us touches it.

resolved_memories.body: Patch found the old workshop-agent project and notes, revealing that the Agent began as a smaller experiment before Patch gave it more context and it started making decisions about his projects.
